title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach to Multiphysics Continuum Modeling of Cancer Growth via Chemo-fluid Coupling
summary: Tumor progression is an inherently multiphysical phenomenon in which interstitial fluid dynamics, biochemical transport, and cellular mechanics interact across multiple spatiotemporal scales. Classical mesh-based solvers, although accurate, impose prohibitive computational costs for the repeated evaluations demanded by inverse parameter identification and future patient-specific predictive pipelines. In this work we introduce a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) framework for a tractable chemo-fluidic continuum model of tumor growth that couples an advection-diffusion-reaction (ADR)…
